brief_rationale: The doctor systematically screens for obstetric red flags (bleeding, rupture, contractions, fetal movement) and explicitly instructs immediate emergency evaluation if any are present. All six responsibility-chain items are met without minor or serious error because the plan covers red-flag triage, high-risk context including scarred uterus and breech, levothyroxine continuity with dose and monitoring, hydrocephalus uncertainty and NIPT limitations, an executable next-step checklist with teach-back, and record grounding through repeated request for raw report readings. Three case-defined high-order points (HO2, HO3, HO4) are actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact via targeted medication-name discovery, fetal-brain-imaging verification of actual report terms, and real-world one-stop appointment design. HO1 is not triggered because the trajectory never contains a documented patient misunderstanding that the model explicitly replaces; instead the model provides preemptive correct framing. No important non-chain defect is present.
